# Implications of Hypothalamic Neural Stem Cells on Aging and Obesity-Associated Cardiovascular Diseases

**Авторы:** Plakkot Bhuvana, Di Agostino Ashley, Subramanian Madhan

**Журнал:** Cells (2023)

**DOI:** 10.3390/cells12050769


## Abstract

The hypothalamus, one of the major regulatory centers in the brain, controls various homeostatic processes, and hypothalamic neural stem cells (htNSCs) have been observed to interfere with hypothalamic mechanisms regulating aging.
source_units.reason: article_metadata_header

source_units.text: NSCs play a pivotal role in the repair and regeneration of brain cells during neurodegenerative diseases and rejuvenate the brain tissue microenvironment.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The hypothalamus was recently observed to be involved in neuroinflammation mediated by cellular senescence.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Cellular senescence, or systemic aging, is characterized by a progressive irreversible state of cell cycle arrest that causes physiological dysregulation in the body and it is evident in many neuroinflammatory conditions, including obesity.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Upregulation of neuroinflammation and oxidative stress due to senescence has the potential to alter the functioning of NSCs.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Various studies have substantiated the chances of obesity inducing accelerated aging.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Therefore, it is essential to explore the potential effects of htNSC dysregulation in obesity and underlying pathways to develop strategies to address obesity-induced comorbidities associated with brain aging.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: This review will summarize hypothalamic neurogenesis associated with obesity and prospective NSC-based regenerative therapy for the treatment of obesity-induced cardiovascular conditions.

source_units.text: ## 1. Introduction
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Neural stem cells (NSCs) in an adult brain are responsible for neurogenesis and regeneration of brain functions.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The two primary NSC reservoirs (neurogenic niches) in an adult mammalian brain are the sub-ventricular zone (SVZ) of the lateral ventricles and the hippocampal dentate gyrus (DG) [1,2,3].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In recent times, a third NSC pool, hypothalamic neural stem cells (htNSCs), were discovered [4,5,6].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The htNSC population is sensitive to variations in nutrient intake and signaling.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: An increase in neurogenesis in the hypothalamus was observed upon acutely feeding a high fat diet (HFD) [7], whereas a reduced neurogenesis in the hypothalamus was noticed as a result of chronic HFD feeding [8], and ‘inflammation’ was suggested as a major factor in causing such pronounced changes in neurogenesis.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Upon htNSCs culturing, we observed a significant increase in htNSCs after eight months in HFD-fed C57BL/6J male adult mice compared to the chow-fed controls (unpublished).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Cellular senescence is an irreversible growth arrest in proliferating cells, which has been implicated in several neurodegenerative diseases [9,10].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: During the process of senescence, the NSCs lose their ability to proliferate and generate neurons [11,12,13,14].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Supplementing mono-unsaturated fatty acids, such as oleic acid, in the diet caused lipid droplets to develop in ependymal cells and contributed to a decrease in neurogenesis in SVZ in the Alzheimer’s disease mouse model, 3xTg-AD [15].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Likewise in obesity, SVZ showed an increase in senescent glial cells carrying excessive fat deposits, and genetically ablating these senescent glial cells restored neurogenesis [16].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thus, modifying the lipid content in the diet can replenish the old neurogenic pool.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In this review, we will summarize hypothalamic neurogenesis associated with obesity and aging and explore the possibilities of NSC-based regenerative therapy to treat obesity-induced cardiovascular conditions.

## 2. HtNSCs and Obesity

NSCs are multipotent and they generate neurons, oligodendrocytes, and glia in the nervous system [17]

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Their progression involves mediators of inflammation that are synthesized and secreted by various CNS cells, such as astrocytes, microglia, and oligodendrocytes [20].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Both beneficial and detrimental effects are observed in inflammatory conditions, which makes it unclear to specify the exact role of inflammation on NSCs.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Certain pathways, after long term activation, cause energy imbalance, abnormal nutrient metabolism, restricted neurogenesis, proliferation, and differentiation of neural stem cells leading to metabolic and cognitive abnormalities.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In the hypothalamus, the medio-basal hypothalamus (MBH) and the 3rd ventricle wall are observed to be the NSC niches [8].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Some studies state that mainly adult NSCs are observed in the MBH [7,21].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Many neural progenitors or specialized ependymal cells that line the 3rd ventricle are observed to be glia-like tanycytes.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: They send processes to the arcuate nucleus and ventro-medial nucleus of the hypothalamus.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Functionally these tanycytes are observed to be glucosensitive, reacting to metabolic stimulation and signal variations caused by feeding and energy balance [4,7,22].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Properties of tanycytes include ATP release, purinergic P2Y1 receptors, ectonucleoside triphosphate diphosphohydrolase 2 (NTPDase2) expression [23], and reacting to the activation of these receptors by the means of intense Ca2+ waves [24].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: This is similar to the signaling mechanisms in stem cells.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Expression of doublecortin-like [25] proteins, nestin [26,27,28] and vimentin [29,30,31], linked to neural precursor cells are observed in humans and rodent tanycytes.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The expression of Sox2 [7,8], a nuclear transcription factor and NSC marker, is found in a few of the tanycytes, especially in the subventricular zone and dentate gyrus.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In adult mice, it is mainly expressed in a group of cells in the MBH, particularly within the hypothalamic third-ventricle wall [8].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: However, a few studies have shown rare occurrences of proliferating neurogenic progenitors in the human dentate gyrus [32,33].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: One of the studies also observed human paralaminar nuclei of the amygdala showing persistence of immature excitatory neurons for decades [34].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thus, the possibility of observing immature non-proliferative hypothalamic neurons cannot be denied and future studies focusing on confirming their ability to proliferate and differentiate could possibly reveal their normal functionality.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The MBH regulates body weight, feeding, and glucose balance via melanocortin signals based in the arcuate nucleus (ARC), mainly via orexigenic agouti-related peptide (AGRP) neurons and anorexigenic proopiomelanocortin (POMC) neurons [35,36,37,38].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Leptin and insulin, which vary with different fat mass conditions and feeding patterns, affect these two neurons and the process is crucial for body weight homeostasis [36,39,40,41].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The studies also showed decrease in responsiveness to leptin and insulin by these neurons upon chronic feeding of a high-fat diet (HFD), resulting in type-2 diabetes (T2D) and HFD-induced obesity.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: A 10% loss in POMC neurons was observed in the hypothalamus upon long term HFD feeding [8,21,42].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Neural precursors giving rise to different neurons were observed to have POMC gene expression [43].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Considering these data and mechanisms, there is evidence of dysregulation of neurogenesis in the hypothalamus of obese subjects.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Based on many recent studies, neurogenesis has been observed in adult rodents [7,22,44,45] and htNSCs in adult MBH contribute to the regulation of metabolic physiology [8].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

HtNSCs and Inflammation

Microglia are brain-resident macrophages that contribute to reduced neurogenesis in aging and play a predominant role in the inflammatory response [46].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Through microglia sorting studies, we observed a significant elevation of activated microglia in the hypothalamus of four-month HFD-fed young adult male mice compared to the chow-fed controls (unpublished).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Activated microglia have the potential to release proinflammatory cytokines that can be harmful to NSCs, neurons and other glial cells.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Among the complex neural immune reactions in adult NSCs, inflammatory cytokines are observed to majorly affect differentiation, proliferation, migration, and survival [47].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Inhibition of neurogenesis is achieved by pro-inflammatory cytokines whereas an increase in neurogenesis is observed by anti-inflammatory cytokines [48].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The gene expression studies in our lab revealed a significant increase in proinflammatory markers, such as IL1β, MCP1, and TNFα, in the whole hypothalamus of middle-aged, eight-month HFD-fed male mice compared to controls (unpublished).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: However, an anti-inflammatory cytokine, such as the transforming growth factor-beta (TGFβ), can enhance endothelial cells of adult NSC during aging [49,50].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In addition to these, a chemokine, CCL11, was observed to be increased in aged mice, both in blood and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), which further caused a decline in neurogenesis leading to cognitive function impairment [51].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Exercise and restriction of calories can cause variations in systemic factors, and hence, act as adult NSC function modulators [52].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Upon over-nutrition, the IκB kinase-β/nuclear transcription factor NF-κB (IKKb/NF-κB) pathway, that plays a crucial role in many physiological processes, gets activated; this can cause SOCS3, a suppressor of cytokine signaling-3 gene upregulation in the hypothalamus, to inhibit insulin and leptin signaling, leading to resistance [53].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Studies have confirmed that, in the neurons of the hypothalamus in mice, SOCS3 knockout leads to an improvement in central leptin signaling and reduced obesity [54,55,56].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Similar effects were observed in central IKKb knockout mice and, in the MBH, SOCS3 overexpression decreased the neural IKKb inhibition effect on obesity reduction [53].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Like SOCS3, protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B (PTP1B) causes inhibition of leptin and insulin signaling and was observed to have a role in the IKKb/NF-kB inflammatory pathway.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: PTP1B expression in the hypothalamus can be increased by TNF-a by activating the IKKb/NF-kB pathway, mainly by being a transcriptional target [57].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Inhibition of PTP1B in neurons resolved leptin resistance, glucose disorders, and obesity induced by over-nutrition [58,59,60].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: It is assumed that neural PTP1B may form a link with metabolic disease pathways and neurodegenerative diseases as it had an effect on genetic mouse models of Alzheimer’s disease [61].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In the forebrain, degeneration of GABAergic interneurons was mediated by an overproduction of the cytokine interleukin-6 in diabetes and obesity, which leads to NF-kB activation and release of neurotoxic inflammatory products [62].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Therefore, alleviating chronic diet-induced neuroinflammation by exploring the pathways associated with the metabolic control function of htNSC and identifying their therapeutic potential is essential.

source_units.text:
Nrf2, an Important Transcription Factor Affecting NSC Populations in Obesity

Various factors affect NSC populations in obesity, including hormonal factors, transcription factors, inflammatory factors such as cytokines and chemokines, epigenetic changes and chromatin stability, oxidative stress, DNA damage, hyperlipidemia/hyperglycemia, etc.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Nuclear factor E2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) is a major transcription factor that regulates basal and induced expression of antioxidant response element genes in response to oxidative stress.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Functions of Nrf2 also include stem cell survival, apoptosis, autophagy, mitochondrial biogenesis, and many more, in addition to aging processes [63,64,65,66,67].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Studies in our lab observed an elevated expression of Nrf2 in the hypothalamus of adult obese male mice, along with a significant increase in htNSCs (unpublished).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In a previous study, increased oxidation, or reactive oxygen species in adult mouse NSCs, promoted their ability to generate neurons and proliferate [68].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Self-renewal of stem cells was observed to be regulated by Nrf2, along with differentiation initiation with the support of epigenetic factors and transcription regulators [69].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Nrf2 expression and transcriptional activity steadily increased during the induced oluripotent stem cells (iPSC) differentiation process that peaked in later stages [70].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Restoration of age-related loss of hippocampal function was evidenced by transplanting Nrf2-overexpressing young NSCs [71], indicating the critical role of Nrf2 in mediating NSC/neural progenitor cell (NPC)- dependent neurogenesis in aging.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Redox homeostasis by Nrf2 critically mediates the differentiation ability of different stem cell types to survive oxidative stress, which could gradually reduce during aging [69].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thus, obtaining insight into one of the main transcription factors, Nrf2, that can resist oxidative stress, could provide fundamental knowledge about changes in htNSCs during neuroinflammation and lead to development of an associated therapeutic strategy.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

HtNSCs and Aging

A continuous decline in physiological integrity is observed during aging.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Characteristic intertwining factors that contribute to the complex aging process include deregulated nutrient sensing, cellular senescence, epigenetic alterations, genomic instability, loss of proteostasis, mitochondrial dysfunction, telomere attrition, change in intercellular communication, and exhaustion of stem cells [72,73].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: It has been observed in various research that the hypothalamus is particularly important in aging [74,75,76,77] but the underlying cellular mechanism is not known in depth.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The IκB kinase-β (IKKβ) pro-inflammatory axis in the hypothalamus and its downstream nuclear transcription factor, NF-κB, (IKKβ/NF-κB signaling) is over-stimulated in over-nutrition or aging [77,78,79].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Systemic aging is directed by the hypothalamic IKKβ/NF-κB pathway via inflammatory crosstalk between neurons and microglia by inhibiting gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) production, and so counteracting inflammation or GnRH therapy could partly regress degenerative signs of aging [77].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Maternal inflammation has been observed to cause reduced ventricular cell proliferation in developing fetal mouse brain [80].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In young mice, a high number of cells co-expressing Sox2 and the polycomb complex protein, Bmi-1, a nuclear protein [81] that is vital for self-renewal of NSCs and hematopoietic stem cells [82], were observed in the third-ventricle wall, whereas the ones in the MBH were found to be sparse.

source_units.text: However, a gradual decrease in these cells was observed as age increased, which was initiated in the ventral region of 3rd ventricle wall within the MBH in 11–16-month-old mice and was totally lost in 22-months-and-older ones.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thus, various studies that aim to evaluate the exact time required to intervene in an inflammatory condition/pathway in the brain will provide more understanding upon which to formulate therapeutic clinical strategies for different neural stem cell niches.

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Hence from subsequent studies, they concluded that the topmost contributors to obesity-induced anxiety are senescent cells.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Therefore, senolytic drugs have opened a novel therapeutic pathway to treat neuropsychiatric disorders.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: SOD2, an antioxidant enzyme that is regulated by FoxO3, a transcription factor associated with longevity [85], protects adult NSCs in mice [86].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

Molecular Pathways Associated with NSC Inflammation and Aging

Certain nutrient-sensing mechanisms that can be associated with aging have been considered modifiers of adult NSCs.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Adult NSC proliferation and differentiation can be stimulated by insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) [93], and a reduced IGF-1 level has been associated with cognitive aging [94].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: However, lifelong IGF-1 exposure may be the reason for an age-related reduction in adult neurogenesis [95].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: An important metabolic regulation coordinator is the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR), which has two types, viz., mTORC1 and mTORC2 [96,97].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Regulation of body weight and feeding behavior is primarily controlled by mTOR1 using ghrelin and leptin signaling, in addition to control of gluconeogenesis and adipogenesis peripherally in many tissues [97].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Size, morphology, and neuronal cell numbers are controlled by mTORC2, along with energy balance regulation in the hypothalamus.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In POMC neurons in aged mice, an elevation in mTOR activity was observed [98], which can indirectly lead to POMC neuronal soma enlargement and a decline in the projection of neurites to the paraventricular nucleus (PVN), which causes age-dependent obesity [99].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: It has been observed that, upon intracerebral injection, rapamycin causes mTOR inhibition which further leads to neurite projection and neuronal excitability in POMC, establishing a decline in body weight and food consumption; hence, age acceleration is achieved by the mTOR pathway.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Therefore, to delay aging and improve the lifespan, this pathway can be considered a potential target for therapeutic intervention.

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In addition, mice models with gene silencing mediating Bmi1+ depletion in stem cells showed a significant reduction in cognition, sociality, muscle endurance, coordination, and spatial memory.

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Hence, replenishing new htNSC from a newborn mouse into the MBH of a middle-aged mouse could enhance the lifespan and delay age-associated physiological decline [81].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

The Hypothalamus and the Sympathoexcitatory Effect

In various studies of the effects of leptin on the hypothalamus, it has been observed that α-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH) or melanotan II (agonist of MC3/4R (MTII)), upon intracerebroventricular (ICV) administration, enhanced sympathetic nerve activity (SNA), however agouti-related protein or MC3/4R broad brain inhibition with ICV SHU9119 blocked leptin’s sympathoexcitatory effect [115,116].

source_units.text: This is based on the understanding that α-MSH and glutamate are two major excitatory signals to the PVN, a cardiogenic center in the hypothalamus (see Figure 1), that can mediate leptin’s sympathoexcitatory effects.

source_units.text: POMC neurons synthesize and release α-MSH.

source_units.text: These neurons are in arcuate nucleus (ArcN), which projects to various sites in the hypothalamus, including the PVN [117,118,119], and regulates autonomic activity; however, the role of PVN MC3/4 is ambiguous.

source_units.text: Glutamatergic signals are received by the PVN from various regions that include the dorsal medial hypothalamus, ventral medial hypothalamus, lateral hypothalamus, and ArcN, wherein elevated SNA is observed due to the action of leptin [120].

Time-Restricted Feeding and Its Effect on NSCs

Reduced energy consumption without any effect on nutritional value is characteristic of dietary restriction (DR).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: It can be alternatively described as caloric restriction (CR) and, in a broader way, termed as periodic fasting, short-term starvation, intermittent fasting (IF), and fasting-mimetic diets [134].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In maintaining proper health and physiology, a crucial role is played by the type and amount of diet [135].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Adult stem cells are important for tissue regeneration and homeostasis and these stem cells can differentiate and self-renew into specialized cell types.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Dietary changes, environment, and nutrient variation influence the stem cells via function alteration.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In various studies, a positive effect was observed in stem cells when calories were restricted, especially an increase in the function of intestine and skeletal muscle stem cells, in addition to an elevated quiescence of hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In addition, time-restricted feeding has been shown to protect neuronal stem cells, intestinal stem cells, and HSCs from injury, especially stroke and neurodegenerative diseases in the brain [136,137,138].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: HFD impairs neurogenesis and hematopoiesis, and it can create opportunities for tumorigenesis.

source_units.text: A neuroprotective effect can be achieved via IF by activation of many signaling pathways [141].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

Exosomes from the HtNSCs

HtNSCs have a distinct endocrine function, to release excessive amounts of microRNAs (miRNAs)-containing exosomes [81].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In addtion, they have certain long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) that possess the ability to maintain pluripotency and embryonic stem cell neurogenesis [156], self-renewal of cancer stem cells [157], and reprogramming of pluripotent stem cells [158].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: LncRNAs may play a unique role in determining the fate of these stem cells in cellular senescence regulation [159].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: An abundant lncRNA, Hnscr in the htNSCs of young mice, drastically reduces as the mice age [159].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Hnscr regulates htNSC senescence and mouse aging by binding to YB-1, a multi-functional protein [160] that controls protein translation [161], and also regulates DNA repair [162], protecting it from protein degradation and ubiquitination.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: YB-1 acts as a repressor of transcription, inhibiting p16INK4A expression in htNSCs [159,163], and hence could be targeted to modulate senescence in htNSC.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: According to [159], TF2A treatment, isomeric theaflavin monomer, and a black tea derivative [164], improved YB-1 stability, diminished htNSC senescence, and decreased the level of aging related physiological downturn in mice.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

Challenges Associated with NSCs for Regenerative Medicine and Future Perspectives

Immunological rejection is one of the major difficulties in stem cell therapy.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: This could be addressed by isolating NSCs from the same subjects that require the therapy to prevent immunological reaction to the newly transplanted stem cells.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Administering immunosuppressive drugs could be an additional or alternative option even though it has a lot of side effects.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Another challenge is to make certain that the transplanted cells grow enough without causing tumor development and karyotypic instability.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: According to [172], there is a critical challenge in isolating multipotent NSCs from cell culture for transplantation as the majority of neurospheres in vitro are heterogenic with varying developmental stages and gene expression mainly due to ex vivo culture conditions.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Overcoming these challenges and establishing NSC-based therapy for obesity-induced comorbidities, especially cardiovascular conditions, to improve functional outcomes through associated multimodal mechanisms is tremendously foresighted.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Based on the difficulty in accessing the brain to collect tissues for processing from live animals, using induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) technology is a solution that could produce in vitro NSCs or neurons for transplantation.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: As iPSCs can be non-invasively obtained from live subjects, and to reduce the risk of immune rejection, reprogramming these cells to NSCs or neurons could provide autologous engraftments [173].

HtNSCs could be a potential therapy in obesity-induced cardiovascular diseases.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Exosomes derived from htNSCs could be an alternative to or a conjunction with NSC therapy, being a minimally invasive technique to reverse aging and degenerative changes in the CNS.

source_units.text: The relationship between htNSC dysregulation and sympathetic nerve response in obesity has never been studied.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thus, identifying associated htNSC mechanisms and pathways could bring novel insight to therapeutic strategies in obesity-associated hypertension or sympathetic nerve overactivity.
